Title: M-series virtual machines (VMs) are now generally available in the France Central region

Body.Content:
Azure M-series VMs are now available in the France Central region. M-series VMs offer configurations with memory from 192 GB to 3.8 TiB (4TB) RAM and are certified for SAP HANA.

For more information on M-series availability by regions and for upcoming region launches, please visit the Azure regions page.

Learn more about SAP on Azure
